message.content: Hey, can you pull up the invoice I sent to the Van der Merwes for their wedding shoot last month?

content.text: I found it. It’s Invoice #4092, dated March 15th, for R45,000. It’s currently marked as 'Unpaid'. Would you like me to draft a reminder email?

message.content: Yes, please. Keep it polite but firm. They promised to pay by the end of March, and it’s already April 6th.

content.text: Understood. I’ve drafted a message referencing the original due date and attaching the invoice PDF again. Shall I send it now?

message.content: Go ahead. While that’s going, can you check if the raw files from that shoot are still backed up on the secondary drive?

content.text: I’m checking the directory structure now. Yes, the folder '2024-03-VanDerMerweds' is intact with all 4,200 raw images. They are also mirrored in your cloud storage.

message.content: Good. Now, I need to get a quote ready for that food photographer who emailed me yesterday. She wants a half-day shoot for a new restaurant menu.

content.text: I have her email in your inbox. Based on your standard rate for commercial food work, a half-day (4 hours) with light setup would be R12,500. Do you want to include two edited hero images?

message.content: Yes, add the two hero edits. But keep the rest of the deliverables as raw files only for now. She might want to do her own retouching.

content.text: Got it. The total comes to R12,500 for the shoot fee plus R3,000 for the two hero edits. Total: R15,500. I’ll generate the quote document for you to review.

message.content: Looks good. Send that quote over to her as well. And remind me to charge Bongo’s vet bill from last week into my expense tracker tonight.

content.text: The quote has been sent. I’ve also added a reminder to your calendar for tonight to log the veterinary expenses under your business account.
